channel.title: WormAgent changelog
channel.description: New updates and improvements to WormAgent

item.title: Built-In Desktop Browser
item.description: Import your sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, and add extensions from Chromium browsers or the Chrome and Edge stores. Everything stays in one persistent desktop profile: chat links open signed in, your tabs survive restarts and the agent can read and drive the same pages without you switching apps.
item.content:encoded:
Import your sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, and add extensions from Chromium browsers or the Chrome and Edge stores. Everything stays in one persistent desktop profile: chat links open signed in, your tabs survive restarts and the agent can read and drive the same pages without you switching apps.

Automations

Ask the agent to run a prompt, a script or a shell command on a timer, on a cron schedule or when an MCP server sends an event, and manage them with /automation. Set "automations": false in your config if you don't want them.

Generate Videos

When a connected provider has a video model, the agent can make videos with generate_video. It keeps working while the video renders and saves the files into your workspace when they're ready.

New TUI Look

The TUI's new designs are on by default, and the wormagent theme is the new one. Pick wormagent-classic in Theme to keep the previous colors.

Windows Taskbar Status

On Windows, the taskbar button shows session progress, counts sessions that need you and flashes when a permission or question is waiting.

Improvements

  • Upgrade notes: Image tool renamed. experimental_image_generate is now generate_image. Permission rules with the old name are mapped automatically, but saved "always allow" approvals are not, so it asks again once.
  • Upgrade notes, Core: Plugins that follow a version now update on their own. A plugin written as name@latest, a version range (such as name@^1.2.0), a Git branch or a Git semver: range is checked on startup and every 24 hours, and a newer match is installed and reloaded. Ranges never leave their range, and if a new version fails to load the previous one keeps running. A bare name, an exact version, another tag such as @next, a Git tag or a commit hash doesn't update itself; wormagent plugin update still updates those by hand.
  • Upgrade notes: GitHub Copilot no longer reads GITHUB_TOKEN. Set COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN or sign in with OAuth.
  • Upgrade notes, Core: MCP servers are tried on the newest protocol first. A server without a protocol setting is probed before falling back to the legacy handshake. Set protocol: "legacy" on a server that misbehaves.
  • Upgrade notes: WormAgent Go connects through WormAgent. The connect dialogs and wormagent auth login list one WormAgent option that includes Go models. WormAgent Go is only listed when a Go key is already saved, and saved keys keep working.
  • Upgrade notes: New desktop shortcut. Cmd+Shift+S (Ctrl+Shift+S on Windows and Linux) now archives the open session. The composer's Cmd+U and Escape/Ctrl+G now follow the Attach file and Stop session shortcuts.
  • Upgrade notes: Code Mode session tool paths moved. tools.wormagent.session_rename and session_move are now tools.wormagent.session.rename and .move. Direct tool names and permission actions are unchanged.
  • Upgrade notes: TUI plugins need OpenTUI 0.9.4. @wormagent/plugin requires @opentui/core and @opentui/solid 0.9.4 or later. Renderers passed to registerCodeBlockRenderer now receive an OpenTUI block (block.text) instead of a Markdown token; codeBlockStyle and escaped are gone.
  • Upgrade notes: SDK: plugins load in the background again. Plugins are meant to load asynchronously, and the server never waits for them. In v2.2.7 the model, provider, generate.*, voice.* and websearch.query endpoints started waiting up to 5 seconds for plugins and returning 503 after that; this release removes that wait. Right after startup these endpoints answer with whatever has loaded, so a list can be empty or partial. Long-lived clients should refresh on the matching *.updated event, such as model.updated. One-shot scripts should wait on their side, for example by polling plugin.list until it returns plugins, or the endpoint until the entry they need appears.
  • Upgrade notes, Desktop: Desktop voice needs a matching server. The app reads each voice model's engine, which older servers don't report, so voice shows as unavailable against a server from before this release.
  • Upgrade notes, Core: Storage write path. Assistant parts are now saved as their own rows. experimental.part_rows: false restores the old path for this release.
  • Core: Added automations. Agents can schedule prompts, Code Mode scripts or fixed shell commands to run once, on an interval, on a cron schedule or when a connected MCP server pushes an event. Use the /automation command or the automation tools. A shell action asks for approval once, when it's created, and records each run's exit code and output. Set "automations": false to turn them off.
  • Core: MCP Events shipped: WormAgent follows the MCP Events beta for push delivery, with argument checks, heartbeats and automatic reconnects. An event too large for its prompt is skipped and its automation keeps running.
  • Core: Agents can generate videos with generate_video whenever a connected provider has a video model. The job runs in the background, survives a server restart, saves the finished videos into the workspace and wakes the agent with their paths. Set a default model with experimental.video_generate.model. The image tool is now called generate_image.
  • Core: The Claude Agent provider has a configDir setting for a Claude config folder other than the default. Given a list of folders, a chat moves to the next account when one hits its usage limit. Claude Agent sessions also show up in Claude Code as coming from wormagent.
  • Core, Extensions: Removing a Sign in with ChatGPT account, with wormagent auth logout or the remove button in the app, now also revokes it with OpenAI.
  • Core: The ChatGPT plan model lists now come from models.dev, so new models show up without an WormAgent update.
  • Core: Voice models are now listed from models.dev, adding newer OpenAI models such as gpt-live-1.1.
  • Core: Reading far into a large file with read, or reading its tail, takes far fewer reads, which is much faster on remote workspaces.
  • Core: The shell tool's result says why a command ended without an exit code, and lists its output after the smaller fields so they survive truncation.
  • Core: Code Mode scripts can define getters and setters, errors have a stack showing where they were thrown, and a failed import says why.
  • Core: A timeout set on a provider now applies to every request, including image, video, speech, transcription, embedding and compaction requests, which previously could hang forever on a stalled provider.
  • Core: Gemma 4 models on Google's Interactions API offer the none and thinking variants, and the provider's safetySettings are sent to Interactions.
  • Core: Added claude-agent as a web search provider. With Claude Agent connected, set "websearch": { "provider": "claude-agent" } to run websearch through Claude Code's WebSearch, which Claude plans include, so any model can search without a search API key.
  • Core: With full_codemode on, agents can call tools.wormagent.session.interrupt to stop another session, its background jobs and its subagents.
  • Core: Stored blobs, such as generated videos, are deleted a week after they were written, so the data folder no longer grows without limit. Copies saved into your project are untouched; GET /api/experimental/blob/:id returns 404 for a deleted blob.
  • Core: Config now reloads only when a file that feeds it changes, not on every write under .wormagent such as editing a skill.
  • Terminal: /login and /auth open the same dialog as /connect, which now lists a single WormAgent entry that includes WormAgent Go models.
  • Terminal: Pressing ↓ opens the picker on the first tab with something running, the same tab that clicking the footer opens.
  • Terminal: Text prompt dialogs such as rename session, /btw, worktree names and connect forms end with a Submit button, and prompt and export dialogs have tighter spacing.
  • Terminal: The wormagent theme's light mode uses lighter grays for the prompt box, selected tabs and hovered rows.
  • Desktop: New tabs that a page opens in the browser pane appear beside the tab they came from, and middle-clicking a link opens it in a new tab.
  • Desktop: Comments in the browser pane, file viewer and review diff can be sent to the session right away with Mod+Enter. Depending on your follow-up setting, they send, steer or queue.
  • Desktop: Added Wrap code blocks under Settings › General › Timeline, plus a Wrap lines button on timeline code blocks with lines too long to fit.
  • Desktop: Added Keep side panel open across sessions in Settings › General.
  • Desktop: Added an Archive session command, bound to Cmd+Shift+S (Ctrl+Shift+S on Windows and Linux).
  • Desktop: The Home session menu has Open and Open in background, and Home shows the provider connect hint when nothing is connected.
  • Desktop: The Inbox layout's sidebar has a Drafts group for unsent new-session drafts.
  • Desktop: Conversation search (Cmd+F / Ctrl+F) has previous and next match buttons.
  • Desktop: The connect dialog lists one WormAgent option that includes WormAgent Go models, Settings › Providers follows the same rule, and the free model picker has a tighter layout.
  • Desktop: When you reach your ChatGPT Business workspace's usage limit, a dialog explains it and offers Copy request for admin.
  • Desktop: Shortcuts go through the same keymap engine as the TUI, and the new Stop session command can be changed in Settings › Shortcuts.
  • Desktop: Shortcuts can be key chords, such as Mod+K Mod+C or G I. In Settings › Shortcuts, click + on a shortcut you just recorded to add another key, up to 4. While a chord is pending, a panel lists the keys that continue it.
  • Desktop: The activity pill keeps a subagent listed while work it started is still running.
  • Desktop: The goal pill has a new design with the labels Following goal, Goal paused and Goal reached.
  • Desktop: Keyboard focus shows as one consistent ring across the app, no longer appears after a mouse click, and moves to the next item when the focused one is removed. The timeline and the composer no longer draw a ring around their whole frame.
  • Desktop: Only the latest response shows its Copy button all the time; older ones show it on hover or focus.
  • Desktop: Added experimental tab groups for side tabs under Settings › Experimental.
  • Desktop: On Windows, the taskbar button shows session status as a progress bar, a count badge for sessions that need you, and flashes when a permission or question is waiting. Notifications say what is being asked and disappear once you answer.
  • Desktop: On Windows, the jump list has New Session and New Window, you can drag files from the file tree into other apps, and Open in includes Windows Terminal and lists only installed apps.
  • Desktop: The web app can be built to run under a path prefix, for example behind a reverse proxy, with bun --cwd packages/app build --base=/wormagent/.
  • Desktop: The background activity menu stays smooth with many subagents, and the model picker stays responsive with catalogs of thousands of models.
  • SDK: Added experimental.job.cancel to cancel a running background job, and an experimental.job.updated event when a job starts, moves to the background or ends. @wormagent/client/solid's createData has a job slice.
  • SDK: The video endpoints (experimental.generate.video.create and .get) no longer need a flag. Video jobs survive a server restart, can return more than one video, and stay readable for 24 hours after they finish.
  • Extensions: A plugin tool can set options.codemode to an object ({ pinned?, description?, input?, output? }) to give its Code Mode form its own description and schemas. Top-level options.pinned still works but is deprecated.
  • Extensions: TUI plugins can read a session's running background jobs with api.data.job.list(sessionID) (experimental).
  • Extensions: GUI plugins can declare their own SVG icons with Plugin.define({ icons }) and use them through ctx.icons. The built-in outline-pair and outline-steer icons were removed.
  • Extensions: The GUI composer API adds composer.send(commentID) and composer.delivery(), and the Browser contract adds experimental.open and experimental.close.

Fixes

  • Core: Fixed GitHub Copilot picking up GITHUB_TOKEN, which git tooling and GitHub Actions often set without Copilot access. It now reads COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN.
  • Core: Fixed shell commands the scanner can't analyze, such as dynamic execution, failing outright. They now ask for permission, and a matching shell deny rule still blocks them.
  • Core: Fixed sessions getting stuck on provider 400 errors after a model called a tool by a dotted name such as a Code Mode path. A Code Mode tool called at the top level now runs as that tool, with a note telling the model to use execute.
  • Core: Fixed a forced tool choice for a namespaced tool naming a tool the request never declared on every provider except native OpenAI Responses.
  • Core: Fixed the shell tool's description not saying which OS and shell commands run in when full_codemode is on.
  • Core: Fixed a revoked or expired ChatGPT sign-in failing every prompt with "Request failed: 400". It now asks you to connect again.
  • Core: Fixed edit and patch replacing every non-UTF-8 character (Latin-1, cp1252, GBK…) with � across the whole file. They now refuse to rewrite such files.
  • Core: Fixed the review pane showing every line as changed in repositories with core.autocrlf=true, and symlinks as modified with core.symlinks=false.
  • Core: Fixed file permission rules not matching other capitalizations of the same path on macOS. Thanks @knp-sap.
  • Core: Fixed the model picker staying empty while a slow project was still loading.
  • Core: Fixed Claude Agent processes staying alive after their session was deleted. Thanks @WTLAIB.
  • Core: Fixed Claude Agent models becoming unavailable after Claude Code renamed them, and Claude Agent now waits up to 60 seconds for its process to start.
  • Core: Fixed shell commands failing with "failed to open output file" after WormAgent's shell output directory was removed.
  • Core: Fixed concurrent shell commands failing on Windows with PowerShell 7 from the Microsoft Store, and stopping one such command killing the others.
  • Core: Fixed wormagent service set password writing the password to the CLI log.
  • Core: Fixed wormagent run hanging when a FIFO is passed as an attachment; it's now rejected right away. Thanks @yang0228.
  • Core: Fixed wormagent <name> crashing with a stack trace when <name> is neither a command nor a directory. It now prints help and the error.
  • Core: Fixed the background service becoming unresponsive at startup with a large database write-ahead log on a slow disk.
  • Core: Fixed a client that opens a session during a running tool call not seeing that tool's progress, such as a running subagent's session.
  • Core: Fixed Markdown commands dropping a separate variant next to model, and agents being skipped when frontmatter repair turned inline lists or objects into strings.
  • Core: Fixed Google Interactions responses stopping early when Google splits a response across requests.
  • Core: Fixed GPT models over OpenAI's WebSocket transport resending the whole conversation after a freeform tool call such as execute or patch.
  • Core: Fixed gpt-6.2-astra and later Astra models getting a 500k context window with ChatGPT sign-in; they stay at 272k.
  • Core: OpenAI cyber_policy and Gemini "terms of use" refusals are now reported as content policy errors. Thanks @lu-zero.
  • Core: Fixed MiniMax text-to-video requests without an aspect ratio being rejected; they now default to 16:9.
  • Core: Fixed several Code Mode built-ins to match Bun: localeCompare and Date toLocale* honor their locale and options, toBase64/fromBase64 honor their options, Buffer map, filter, slice and subarray return a Buffer, and Uint8Array.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT is defined.
  • Core: Fixed large file views not refreshing when only the end of the file changed.
  • Core: Fixed the install script failing with a disk-space error when curl is installed through Snap.
  • Terminal: Fixed connect forms built from integration fields, such as the Azure resource name, showing an empty row between the title and the input.
  • Terminal: Fixed list dialogs ending with two blank rows, and the Manage workspaces footer not staying at the bottom.
  • Terminal: Fixed long dialog lists replacing their last visible row with a stray ….
  • Terminal: Fixed the selection bar of a delete-confirmation row staying blue instead of red.
  • Terminal: Fixed file, agent and skill mentions landing on the wrong text when you restore a prompt sent from the desktop or web app that contains tabs or wide characters.
  • Desktop: Fixed wormagent://open-project and wormagent://new-session links doing nothing.
  • Desktop: Fixed file links like ~/Downloads/clip.mp4 showing "File not found". ~ now opens in the server's home folder.
  • Desktop: Fixed an open session's side panel tabs disappearing after you had used many other sessions.
  • Desktop: Fixed the app freezing when opening a session on a remote server with Share sign-ins with remote servers on.
  • Desktop: Fixed the app freezing for several seconds when you open a group of long Code Mode scripts. An Execute row now lists its latest 10 calls, with +N more for the earlier ones.
  • Desktop: Fixed the browser pane showing "The browser couldn't open" in a project whose server had only just started.
  • Desktop: Fixed Clear browsing data clearing everything on the first click; it now asks first.
  • Desktop: Fixed browser tabs showing a generic globe instead of the site's icon, saved tabs appearing late after the app reopens, and the page going blank while a panel is resized on Windows.
  • Desktop: Fixed sites in the browser pane replacing the app's badge on the taskbar or Dock.
  • Desktop: Fixed the mouse Back and Forward buttons doing nothing.
  • Desktop: Fixed a subagent's pending permission request not reappearing after a reload or reconnect.
  • Desktop: Fixed background jobs that changed while the job list was loading showing the wrong state, and rows in the activity menu jumping around.
  • Desktop: Fixed the session view crashing when a timeline row disappeared mid-update.
  • Desktop: Fixed earlier replies being folded into the "Used N tools" group when a session was woken without a new message.
  • Desktop: Fixed the Context tab showing the latest instruction update as the "System Prompt".
  • Desktop: Fixed the session header briefly showing the wrong worktree while a new session starts.
  • Desktop: Fixed Grep, Glob and List rows showing the parent of the folder they searched, and Windows paths not showing relative to the project.
  • Desktop: Fixed server event streams going stale after Windows wakes from sleep, and windows reopening in the wrong place after being snapped or minimized.
  • Desktop: Fixed the Windows caption buttons being hard to see with a contrast theme.
  • Desktop: Fixed Open in PowerShell on Windows opening Windows PowerShell instead of PowerShell 7 when it's installed.
  • Desktop: Fixed builds packaged without app-update.yml, such as AUR packages, showing update-check errors. Settings now shows Updates unavailable.
  • Desktop: Fixed the message menu's "Today" and "Yesterday" labels, and Home's date headers staying invisible while scrolling.
  • Desktop: Fixed clipped or misleading focus rings, the side panel's add button being skipped by Tab, and the Compacted label only partly highlighting on hover.
  • Desktop: Fixed the Hex voice tip showing on phones and tablets, and a fringe on project icon corners.

Released in v2.4.0

item.title: GPT-6.2 Prompt Caching
item.description: GPT-6.2 models don't cache a system prompt sent in the Responses instructions field, so every step re-billed it as uncached input. WormAgent now sends it as a leading developer message on every Responses route, including OpenAI (API key and ChatGPT sign-in), GitHub Copilot, Zen, Azure and OpenRouter, so it is cached from the second step on.

item.title: Timed-Out Shell Commands Keep Running
item.description: A shell command still running when its timeout expires now moves to the background instead of being killed, so long builds and test runs finish and report back. A foreground timeout: 0 now means the default 120 seconds.
item.content:encoded:
A shell command still running when its timeout expires now moves to the background instead of being killed, so long builds and test runs finish and report back. A foreground timeout: 0 now means the default 120 seconds.

Compaction Without the Wait

As a session nears automatic compaction, the summary is now written in the background, so your next prompt doesn't pause for it. Set compaction.background: false to turn it off; a background summary that ends up unused still costs tokens.

GPT 6.2 with ChatGPT Sign-In

GPT 6.2 Sol and GPT 6.2 Astra, plus their fast variants, now show up in the model picker when you sign in with ChatGPT.

Update Plugins from Settings

Open Settings › Extensions, click Check for updates, then Update on any plugin with a new version.

Comment on Selected Code

Selecting code in diff and file viewers now just selects it, so you can copy it, and an Add comment toolbar appears beside the selection.

Improvements

  • Core: WormAgent again reads CLAUDE.md in any directory that has no AGENTS.md, and falls back to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md when the global AGENTS.md is missing. This also applies to instructions found when the agent reads nested files. Set WORMAGENT_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE or WORMAGENT_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT to skip every CLAUDE.md.
  • Core: websearch now returns a flat list of results, each with its url, title, content and published date.
  • Core: Code Mode and plugins get a simpler structured result from read: text (with offset, lineCount and next), directory (entry names) or media (a URI instead of base64). What the model sees is unchanged.
  • Core: Code Mode programs can use Node's Buffer for encoding and decoding bytes.
  • Core: In Code Mode, search("issues") now works as shorthand for search({ query: "issues" }).
  • Core: Code Mode tool summaries in the catalog can now be up to 500 characters instead of 120, so the model sees more of each tool's description.
  • Core: The glob and grep tools now report a malformed filename glob (for example [) as an error that names the parameter to fix, instead of returning no results.
  • Core, SDK: Server requests that crash now return a 500 with a readable JSON UnknownError body instead of an empty one. Storage problems name the cause (for example "Storage is full" or "Storage is read-only"); other crashes include a ref you can find in the server log.
  • Core: The shell tool description now tells the model that its session ID is in the WORMAGENT_SESSION_ID environment variable.
  • Core, SDK: Experimental schedules are now automations, behind the automations flag (the old schedules flag still works). An automation runs on a time, an interval, a cron or a pushed MCP event, and either sends a prompt (to the creating session, another session or a new subagent) or runs a Code Mode program that decides whether to send one. Use /automation or the automation_* tools. Active or paused plain prompt schedules carry over; schedules with a condition or run limit, and finished ones, are dropped.
  • Terminal: Permission prompts from a subagent, and from that subagent's own subagents, now appear while you view the subagent's session. Prompts also show in front of an open composer.
  • Terminal: The export dialog under the new designs can save to the system temp directory as well as the project folder. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Terminal: Removed time to first token (ttft) from the assistant message footer. Tokens per second still shows when session.tps is on.
  • Desktop: You can check for and install plugin package updates from Settings › Extensions. Use Check for updates to look for new versions, then click Update on any plugin that has one.
  • Desktop: Cmd+F (Ctrl+F) now finds text in Markdown, Mermaid, CSV and HTML previews in the side panel, using the same find bar as the code view.
  • Desktop: Disconnecting a provider or removing an account in Settings → Providers now asks for confirmation first. Disconnecting WormAgent Console says how many providers will stop working.
  • Desktop: The model picker's variant flyout now follows the keyboard: it opens beside the highlighted row, → enters it to pick a variant or toggle Favorite, and ← or Escape goes back. A model's Console budget and reset time now show in the flyout.
  • Desktop: When New worktree is selected for a new session, the composer shows the base branch (from dev ▾). Click it to pick another base; the choice applies immediately, and Use main checkout switches back.
  • Desktop: Redesigned the folder picker for remote servers, with a path bar, up to three recent-project pills plus a More projects menu, and a search box that shows the selected folder.
  • Desktop: `latex and `math code fences now render as display math once complete.
  • Desktop: The new icon set is now the default, and the New icons experiment has been removed.
  • Desktop: The copy button under assistant messages is now always visible. Message metadata still appears on hover.
  • Desktop: Text files opened in side-panel tabs now have the same copy and download actions as other files.
  • Desktop: Manage models now shows every provider as a card with a ⋯ menu, whether or not you're signed in to WormAgent Console.
  • Desktop: The connect provider dialog has a cleaner layout for every sign-in step: breadcrumbs, method icons, full-width device codes, and a "Signing in from another device?" row for pasting a redirect URL.
  • Desktop: Collapse long messages is no longer experimental. It is now a setting under Timeline preferences.
  • Desktop: Settings now opens on your client preferences, which are listed first, pairing is grouped with Servers, and there's a Help & feedback link.
  • Desktop: Pairing QR codes can carry a server name, which becomes the paired server's default name.
  • Desktop: Image attachment thumbnails are larger, with a 3:2 crop, and a failed image no longer moves the message below it when retried.
  • Desktop: The Hex voice tip no longer appears when Hex is already installed, its copy now says what Hex is, and tips wait an hour after first launch before the first one shows.
  • Desktop: Added missing translations for every non-English language, about 920 strings each.
  • Extensions: Each tool call inside a Code Mode program now has its own call ID in plugin hooks and traces. Its permission requests still show on the execute call's row.
  • Extensions: Plugin SessionIdleBackground items can now be { kind: "codemode", sessionID, jobID }, and GUI plugin BridgeLayout accepts an optional clip rectangle.

Fixes

  • Core: Fixed finished shell commands leaving zombie processes under wormagent-pty. The process daemon now cleans each command up when it exits. Background processes started by a successful command (cmd &) keep running, and a failed command's leftovers are stopped.
  • Core: Fixed ChatGPT and OpenAI subscription logins losing their sharing-limit safeguards and context caps when a token refresh failed.
  • Core: Fixed Claude Agent models falling back to a 200K context window when Claude Code adds or renames a model. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Core: Fixed requests being rejected after switching models mid-session on OpenAI-compatible providers. Models that declare a different reasoning field (such as reasoning_content) no longer receive reasoning_details from earlier turns.
  • Core: Rejecting a permission request now rejects only the other pending requests from the same step, not every pending request in the session.
  • Core: Fixed a finished subagent being reported to its parent as still running when its answer quoted the "Background work still running" heading.
  • Core: Fixed ACP clients missing turns that a background shell woke after the original turn ended.
  • Core: Reading a small text file now applies the default line and byte limits, so a short file with very many lines is paged instead of returned whole.
  • Core: Paged reads that select a single blank line now return that line instead of an empty result.
  • Core: read now rejects limit: 0 with "Limit must be a positive integer".
  • Core: Text files that start with BM are no longer mistaken for BMP images, and only real GIF87a/GIF89a headers count as GIFs, so these files read as text again.
  • Core: Fixed shell output pages, grep previews, generated titles, read lines and shell output tails splitting emoji and other multi-byte characters, which showed up as �.
  • Core: Shell commands using unknown ANSI-C escapes such as $'\q' are now read the same way Bash and Zsh read them, so permission rules can match them.
  • Core: Session title search is now case-insensitive for non-ASCII letters, such as Cyrillic and accented text.
  • Core: Fixed grep results being dropped when a matching line or path is not valid UTF-8. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Core: The @ file picker now finds files in hidden folders such as .github/ and dotfiles such as .env.example when file search uses ripgrep (the default on Windows and outside git repos). .git and gitignored files stay excluded. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Core: An unreachable well-known integration source is now skipped instead of dropping every well-known source. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Core: A corrupt cached project ID is now ignored instead of being used. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Core: Plugin tool renames from tool.execute.before now apply to calls inside Code Mode programs, and a renamed call returns the new tool's structured result.
  • Core: In Code Mode, calling a tool that doesn't exist now returns a rejected promise, so .catch and Promise.allSettled can handle it instead of the whole script failing.
  • Core: A Code Mode program that only logs no longer shows a stray null line before its logs.
  • Terminal: When another TUI sharing your tabs closes the session you're viewing, closing it here now moves to the neighbouring tab.
  • Terminal: Fixed broken characters at the edges of the shell output viewer and the inline shell display when output is long.
  • Desktop: Fixed the desktop app failing to start when drafts.sqlite was a symlink to or copy of the CLI's wormagent.db. The desktop now moves that file aside and creates its own, leaving the CLI database untouched.
  • Desktop: Switching session tabs with a keyboard shortcut now focuses the composer.
  • Desktop: Long prompts now stay folded while a new session is being created.
  • Desktop: On macOS, the browser pane stays live while you resize panels instead of showing a still image.
  • Desktop: Submenus now open one at a time and swap without blinking, and stay open while you move the pointer across other items to reach them.
  • Desktop: Pressing a button now dismisses its tooltip until you hover it again, and copy buttons show "Copied" for two seconds, including in the /btw panel.
  • Desktop: Dialogs now use consistent sizes, corner radius and row styles across the command palette, session search, model picker, location picker and other lists.
  • Desktop: Sessions on WormAgent Go no longer show a $0.00 cost.
  • Desktop: Use main checkout now stays on one line in the branch picker, and wrapped question descriptions have better spacing.
  • Desktop: Restyled the Timeline detail slider and visibility buttons in settings so they read as clickable.
  • Desktop: Polished small details: animated counts no longer look faded at rest, the sidebar resize pill is hidden, the sidebar peek insets match, subagent breadcrumbs show a hover background, and screen readers name the redirect URL field after its label only.
  • SDK: Apps embedding the SDK with an in-memory database no longer import the user's legacy auth.json credentials. Only a database file opened by path imports them.
  • Extensions: The browser extension's URL bar action buttons are now spaced 6px apart.

Released in v2.3.1

item.title: WormAgent 1 now offers the upgrade to WormAgent 2.0
item.description: WormAgent 1 now offers the upgrade to WormAgent 2.0. WormAgent 2 downloads in the background and installs only when you choose: Restart to upgrade, Upgrade on quit, or Later. Your sessions, projects, and settings are kept. Plugins made for WormAgent 1 need an update.
item.content:encoded:
WormAgent 1 now offers the upgrade to WormAgent 2.0. WormAgent 2 downloads in the background and installs only when you choose: Restart to upgrade, Upgrade on quit, or Later. Your sessions, projects, and settings are kept. Plugins made for WormAgent 1 need an update.

Fixes

  • Core: Sessions with many images no longer send oversized requests. When the images in a session's history pass 25 MiB, the oldest are replaced with a placeholder.
  • Core: A provider error for a request body that is too large now starts compaction and a retry instead of failing the turn.

Released in v1.19.6

item.title: Background Subagents by Default
item.description: Subagents now return immediately, continue in the background, and report back whenever they become idle. You can keep working in the parent session while multiple subagents run concurrently.
item.content:encoded:
Subagents now return immediately, continue in the background, and report back whenever they become idle. You can keep working in the parent session while multiple subagents run concurrently.

Quieter Transcripts by Default

The TUI now summarizes each run of tool calls and thoughts into one collapsible activity row, so the answer is easier to follow. To see every step again, set Verbosity to medium or high in settings, or set session.verbosity in your TUI config; an existing setting is kept.

Jump to an Earlier Prompt

In the desktop app, open Jump to message from the command palette or press Cmd+Alt+G (Ctrl+Alt+G on Windows and Linux) to search prompts across the current session and jump directly to one.

Improvements

  • Core: Added experimental support for MCP events, behind the mcp_events flag.
  • Core: Shell commands now survive server handoffs and keep their output when interrupted.
  • Core: Added experimental support for moving a shell command to the background when its timeout expires, behind the shell_timeout_background flag. With the flag on, an explicit timeout on a background command stops it.
  • Core: Local Windows shell commands now run through the process daemon.
  • Core: Added support for freeform tool input on compatible models.
  • Core: Added LM Studio decision-model support.
  • Core: Agents are now told when their session is a fork. Thanks @hasta84.
  • Core: Tool output truncation now keeps the beginning of the output and preserves a usable preview if the full output cannot be saved.
  • Core: Tail reads no longer load the entire file into memory.
  • Core: Providers can present a client certificate for gateways that require mutual TLS. Set settings.tls with cert, key and an optional passphrase on the provider; values accept {file:} and {env:} like apiKey.
  • Core: When a subagent goes idle while its own background work is still running, its report to the parent now says it is still running, so the parent waits for the final report instead of treating the partial answer as done.
  • Core: Code Mode gets simpler structured results from file and skill tools: write and edit return their confirmation as a string, patch returns an empty result, and skill returns the skill's directory and content.
  • Terminal: Session IDs found in messages can now be opened directly.
  • Terminal: Activity tabs are clickable and open the correct view.
  • Terminal: Shell mode has its own prompt color under the new designs.
  • Desktop: Added the experimental Recent sessions sidebar, with cross-server recency, local pins, reordering, and standard session-row actions.
  • Desktop: Recent sessions are limited to the last seven days and 30 rows, and can be hidden or muted.
  • Desktop: Added an experimental customizable sessions sidebar.
  • Desktop: Mermaid diagrams can now be maximized for zooming and panning.
  • Desktop: Added Alt+Enter to place a follow-up first in the queue and Mod+Enter to steer the next queued prompt.
  • Desktop: Holding the modifier key now shows tab shortcut numbers.
  • Desktop: Each server’s terminal shell can be selected from its menu.
  • Desktop: Added a free-limit panel in place of the composer when applicable.
  • Desktop: Session IDs are easier to find and copy.
  • SDK: Event subscriptions can now receive experimental.mcp.event events from MCP event subscriptions.
  • SDK: Model capability schemas now advertise supported freeform tool-input formats.
  • SDK: Session throughput is now measured from the first streamed token.
  • SDK: Session creation documentation now clarifies the parentID field.
  • Extensions: Promise-based tools can cooperatively stop through ToolContext.signal.
  • Extensions: Added the experimental session.fork hook.
  • Extensions: Promise plugin cleanup failures no longer prevent subsequent plugin replacements.
  • Extensions: @wormagent/plugin/effect now exports Tool, so an execute.before hook can reject a call with Tool.Error without importing @wormagent/schema/tool.

Fixes

  • Core: Fixed case-only file renames in patches on case-insensitive filesystems.
  • Core: Fixed stale thinking being retained after Claude Agent prompts or tools change.
  • Core: Fixed directly driven child sessions not resuming after a restart.
  • Core: Fixed plugin replacement stopping when cleanup of an earlier plugin fails.
  • Core: Fixed MCP OAuth refreshes and localhost redirects when a server rewrites 127.0.0.1.
  • Core: Fixed saved API keys being omitted from local-model discovery.
  • Core: Local model discovery (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) waits up to 15 seconds per request instead of 1, so remote or tunnelled endpoints list their models, and a slow endpoint no longer delays other endpoints or config reloads.
  • Core: In Code Mode, calling a namespace as if it were a tool now suggests up to three real tools under it.
  • Core: Fixed retryable provider streams losing completed work when interrupted.
  • Core: Fixed GitHub Copilot requests using the wrong endpoint before models finish loading.
  • Core: Fixed exhausted request rate limits being treated as terminal. Thanks @Kyle-j-bush.
  • Core: Fixed LM Studio models with a null context length and accepted decision-type models. Thanks @tomzhu1024.
  • Terminal: Restored pasted text when undo brings back its placeholder.
  • Terminal: Restored the live draft after browsing prompt history.
  • Terminal: Fixed copying a paste from within the prompt selection.
  • Terminal: Preserved the Mini composer caret when closing the command palette.
  • Terminal: Prevented image bytes from being retained in transcript storage when image previews are disabled.
  • Terminal: Fixed paste-chip contrast across light and dark themes.
  • Terminal: Fixed plugin-provided themes updating live.
  • Terminal: Session lists now open at the top rather than at the current session.
  • Terminal: Mini scrollback now shows the subagent card instead of obsolete launch instructions.
  • Desktop: Recent sessions now keep stable recency ordering through list reloads, renames, and completed runs.
  • Desktop: Fixed browser panes not retrying after server plugins finish loading.
  • Desktop: Fixed mention suggestions being recreated while typing.
  • Desktop: Fixed SSH prompts failing to advance or close after connection.
  • Desktop: Fixed pasted provider-auth redirect URLs being rejected.
  • Desktop: Restored message footers in the New timeline.
  • Desktop: Fixed links whose labels contain inline code.
  • Desktop: Fixed the desktop main process freezing while probing the login-shell environment.
  • Desktop: Fixed the drag region after changing layout direction.
  • Desktop: Fixed vertical-tab previews snapping to the wrong tab.
  • Desktop: Fixed the file-tree sidebar opening animation.
  • Desktop: Fixed pairing QR-code contrast in light themes. Thanks @ssskay.
  • Desktop: Fixed activity-tab navigation and click handling. Thanks @OpeOginni.

Released in v2.3.0

item.title: GitHub Copilot Auto
item.description: Pick Auto in the model picker when your Copilot account has an Auto pool, and Copilot's router chooses the model for each session at the Auto discount. If routing fails, WormAgent falls back to the account's default chat model.
item.content:encoded:
Pick Auto in the model picker when your Copilot account has an Auto pool, and Copilot's router chooses the model for each session at the Auto discount. If routing fails, WormAgent falls back to the account's default chat model.

Side Panel Tab Shortcuts

Right-click a side panel tab and choose Close tabs to the right. ⌘W now closes side panel tabs wherever focus is, ⌥⌘W or Ctrl+Alt+W always closes the session tab, and ⌘⇧T reopens the last closed tab of either kind where it was.

Mark Sessions Read or Unread

Open the menu on a tab, Home row, project row or inbox card and choose Mark as unread to keep its dot until you next visit.

Breaking changes

@wormagent/ai: ImageResponse.image is removed This affects code that imports @wormagent/ai directly. Read response.images[0] instead of response.image.

SDK: fewer endpoints wait for plugins to load On a Location that is still loading plugins, agent.list returns the agents loaded so far, and integration.list, usage.limits, vcs.init, rpc.call and artifact.* no longer wait up to 5 seconds. Entries and actions that a plugin provides appear when it finishes loading, so refresh on the matching *.updated event. Model, provider, generate.*, voice.* and websearch.query endpoints still wait.

Improvements

  • Core: MCP Logins Stay Signed In: Remote MCP servers that rotate refresh tokens no longer sign you out when several clients refresh at once or the token endpoint fails for a moment.
  • Core: read accepts a negative offset to read from the end of a file, such as -50 for the last 50 lines. An offset past the end returns the last lines and the file's line count instead of failing.
  • Core: Shell results end with Exit code: N. Commands killed by a signal show the signal name, and timeouts say how long they waited and suggest a larger timeout.
  • Core: Prompt cache warming times its pings from the model's cache.ttl by default (interval: "auto"), or every 4 minutes without a TTL. Models whose cache outlasts the warming duration are no longer pinged.
  • Core: When MCP servers connect, disconnect or change tools, Code Mode sends the model a short list of what changed instead of the whole tool catalog.
  • Terminal: The update and confirm dialogs have buttons you can move between with ←/→ and Tab/Shift+Tab.
  • Terminal: The model picker no longer has a Usage action; use /usage instead.
  • Desktop: The answer you pick in the question dock shows as a raised card.
  • Desktop: Inline rename and custom-answer fields no longer show a focus border.
  • SDK: session.generate returns tokens and cost along with text.
  • SDK: credential.updated includes the integrationID and credentialID of the login that changed.
  • SDK: Predicate questions in client.experimental.generate.decisions accept optional criteria: { true?, false? }.
  • Extensions: ACP clients can redirect a running turn with the _session/steering extension, advertised as _meta.steering.supported in initialize.

Fixes

  • Core: GitHub Copilot session costs use the amount Copilot charged instead of the catalog estimate, and content-filter errors name the filter that blocked the response.
  • Core: GitHub Copilot picks up a new API endpoint after a plan change on its next model refresh, so you no longer have to sign in again.
  • Core: Remote MCP servers that rotate refresh tokens no longer log you out when the TUI, desktop app, background service or several projects refresh the same login at once.
  • Core: A temporary failure while refreshing an MCP OAuth token keeps your login for the next try instead of marking the server needs_auth.
  • Core: MCP tool calls no longer fail when the server's result doesn't match the tool's own output schema, so completed actions aren't reported as failed.
  • Core: MCP prompts stay available when refreshing a server's prompt list fails.
  • Core: With background_compaction on, a background summary no longer stops a running Claude Agent session mid tool call.
  • Core: After wormagent auth logout on a .well-known integration, its remote providers and policies stop applying until you log back in.
  • Core: WormAgent Console workspace policies still apply when Console's instructions or skills fail to load.
  • Core: Cloudflare AI Gateway providers set up with only gatewayApiKey now send that key.
  • Core: A v1 model override that sets only some capabilities no longer resets the others, so catalog capabilities like PDF input are kept.
  • Core: A v1 provider config that sets both api and options.baseURL keeps options.baseURL.
  • Core: Legacy model references with an inline variant, such as "openai/gpt-5#high", keep the variant.
  • Core: A fresh install imports saved provider credentials from the legacy auth.json, and skips an invalid one with a warning instead of stopping setup.
  • Core: Cache warming stops for a session when a ping rebuilds the cache instead of reading it, counts its interval from when a request was sent, and no longer pings during compaction or after the session is deleted.
  • Core: Tokens and cost from session.generate requests, including cache warming pings, count toward the session's totals.
  • Core: Under zsh, a glob that matches nothing, like rm *.tmp, is passed through as bash does instead of stopping the command.
  • Core: On Windows, multi-line commands no longer lose everything after the first line with PowerShell 7 from the Microsoft Store.
  • Core: read no longer cuts an emoji in half when it shortens a long line.
  • Core: Generated session titles no longer include the model's commentary.
  • Core: Markdown agents whose description starts with a bracketed tag, like [Beta] Reviews code, now load.
  • Core: Markdown agent and command files that fail to load log a warning with the file path and frontmatter error.
  • Core: Markdown agent discovery skips node_modules.
  • Core: Failed plugin installs from git show git's own error instead of "An unknown git error occurred".
  • Terminal: Session exports are saved in the current working directory instead of the system temp folder.
  • Terminal: Typing a child session's exact ID in the open-session menu lists that session.
  • Terminal: The TUI follows the terminal's current light or dark mode instead of a cached palette.
  • Desktop: On Windows and Linux, Ctrl+Shift+R toggles the review panel again instead of reloading the window.
  • Desktop: Closing the last side panel tab slides the panel shut.
  • Desktop: Selects, menus, tooltips and toasts opened from a dialog are reachable by screen readers.
  • Desktop: An error appears when a path can't be opened in its default app.
  • Desktop: Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All in the right-click menu follow the app language.
  • Desktop: Ukrainian tool titles use nouns.
  • Desktop: Scrolling titlebar search results no longer jumps back when late results arrive, the inbox no longer announces already-running sessions as working on load, and the quote toolbar comes back after Escape.

Released in v2.2.7

item.title: Shared MCP Connections
item.description: Turn on pooling for an MCP server to share one connection across projects with the same setup, so you run fewer processes and start faster.
item.content:encoded:
Turn on pooling for an MCP server to share one connection across projects with the same setup, so you run fewer processes and start faster.

GUI Plugin Themes and New Slots

GUI plugins can now add color themes, render or add actions to code blocks, and use native settings and menu components.

Mobile Composer Dock

On phones and tablets, composer actions now sit in a touch dock above the keyboard with larger buttons.

Scripted Runs in Worktrees

Run wormagent run -w to start the session in a new git worktree, or --worktree=<name> to name it.

Automatically Archived Runs

Add --archived to wormagent run to keep scripted and CI sessions out of your inbox and session lists.

Improvements

  • Core: Added provider- and model-specific session warming settings, including an interval: "auto" mode based on cache TTL.
  • Core: Added the websearch.use policy action and switches for enabling all feature flags with WORMAGENT_FLAGS=all or experimental.all_flags.
  • Core: Added an experimental bytecode VM for Code Mode. It is off by default; turn it on with experimental.codemode_vm: true or WORMAGENT_FLAGS=codemode_vm.
  • Core: Added support for Microsoft Store installations of PowerShell 7 on Windows.
  • Core: Added Azure Messages support for Foundry Claude models.
  • Terminal: Added Scroll on send in Settings. Choose Keep (session.submit_scroll: "keep") to retain your reading position after submitting a prompt.
  • Desktop: Added close-other-tabs and close-tabs-after actions to the tab menu.
  • Desktop: Added unread-session grouping in Inbox and failed-run indicators on tabs.
  • Desktop: MCP sign-in now accepts a pasted redirect URL when automatic redirection is unavailable.
  • Desktop: Markdown file previews now display frontmatter as a properties list.
  • Desktop: The command palette shows a date instead of "Xd ago" for sessions 7 or more days old. Hover the time to see the full date and time.
  • Desktop: Prompt history now keeps up to 200 prompts. Past the newest 100, only prompts without attachments are kept.
  • SDK: Added client.experimental.job.list() and its Effect equivalent for listing background shell, subagent, and image jobs, with session, descendant, kind, and status filters.
  • SDK: Server embedders can provide a custom fetch implementation for WormAgent HTTP, model, web, and remote MCP traffic.

Fixes

  • Core: wormagent run now waits for the background shell commands, subagents, and image jobs that its prompt started, then lets the model respond to their results before it exits. While it waits, it prints waiting for N background job(s) (a background_wait event with --format json). There is no time limit: a job that never exits, such as a dev server or file watcher, keeps the run open until you press Ctrl+C or send SIGTERM, so set a timeout on CI jobs.
  • Core: Reworked noninteractive wormagent run execution so arguments, cancellation, compiled WebSocket upgrades, and service shutdown complete reliably. SIGTERM now cancels the session and its background jobs and exits with code 143.
  • Core: Serve file reads and media from the server API as sandboxed downloads, and refuse cross-site browser navigations and requests from disallowed origins to /api/*, so a file in your project cannot run scripts on the server's origin.
  • Core: Webfetch and Code Mode fetch now reject URLs that contain credentials and ignore the #fragment when matching permission rules, and Code Mode fetch checks every redirect against your webfetch rules.
  • Core: Ask for external_directory permission before session_move leaves the current project.
  • Core: Wait up to 2 seconds for MCP servers that are still connecting before a model call, so tools from servers that connect quickly reach the first prompt and wormagent run. Also expand ~ in local MCP working directories, handle legacy stdio servers, and send logo_uri during dynamic registration.
  • Core: Time out WormAgent Console config requests after 5 seconds, so startup no longer hangs when the Console accepts the connection but never answers.
  • Core: Retry provider requests while their host is unreachable and recover prematurely ended Cohere streams.
  • Core: Keep legacy custom providers whose models set only part of limit, such as only limit.context, instead of dropping the whole provider without an error. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Core: wormagent acp now removes a session that a client creates with session/new and closes without prompting, so IDE integrations no longer leave empty sessions behind.
  • Core: Prevent repeated zsh q flags from freezing shell permission scanning. Thanks @yangguan-xue.
  • Core: Allow npm upgrade install scripts again. Thanks @renatomoselli.
  • Terminal: Allow Ctrl+Z to suspend WormAgent while a form or dialog is open.
  • Terminal: Keep focus on an open dialog when a question arrives and contain plugin dialogs that throw during rendering.
  • Terminal: Show an error when Ctrl+V cannot read the clipboard. Thanks @jimmyallinai.
  • Terminal: Prevent session titles containing newlines from crashing the TUI. Thanks @vishalshekhar.
  • Terminal: Improved message spacing and prevented older history from flashing while scrolling.
  • Terminal: Jump to the first or last message with Home, End, and Ctrl+G in subagent sessions. Thanks @ricky9408.
  • Terminal: Keypad Home, End, Page Up, and Page Down now navigate the transcript like the main keys in terminals that use the kitty keyboard protocol. Thanks @argszero.
  • Terminal: wormagent mini now uses the agent colors from your config. Thanks @ferdinandyb.
  • Terminal: Return to the /mcp list after signing in to an MCP server, with that server still selected. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Terminal: Allow favoriting models with Ctrl+F in /models when they come from a provider declared in config or an add-on instead of a saved connection. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Desktop: Improved prompt submission and timeline behavior during loading, reconnects, retries, scrolling, compaction, and optimistic delivery.
  • Desktop: Surface loading and offline failures in review previews, file search, details, Word pages, and review diffs instead of showing empty or clean results.
  • Desktop: Fixed provider connection, MCP sign-in, settings, and plugin loading flows that could become stuck after failures.
  • Desktop: Preserve drafts, focus, caret position, queued prompts, and selected terminal tabs across failed or concurrent transitions.
  • Desktop: Restart plugins after failed update handoffs and recover the renderer, storage, event stream, and background-service connection from transient failures.
  • Desktop: Corrected V2 file labels and mention syntax. Thanks @velmet and @cheapredwine.
  • Desktop: Attach only the @mentions in a line comment that match an existing file or folder, so a comment such as Check @here no longer fails the send. Render partial diffs in the review pane when it shows all lines, instead of a blank pane. Thanks @Tarquinen.
  • Desktop: Keep pasted images sendable after the clipboard tool deletes its temporary file. Thanks @lfscqk67.
  • Desktop: While an input method is composing text, Escape, Enter, and Tab go to the input method instead of stopping the agent or picking a suggestion.
  • Desktop: Fixed padding in the WSL distribution picker, the position of worktree and branch labels in Home search results, and the selected ring on the Interface layout setting. Thanks @inuyume.
  • Extensions: Isolated plugin dialogs, Markdown renderers, terminal views, lazy chunks, and artifact viewers so failures do not take down their host surface.

Released in v2.2.6

item.title: Worktree and Shell Mode Shortcuts
item.description: Press ⌘⌥O on macOS or Ctrl+Alt+O on Windows and Linux to choose a worktree, and ⌘⌥B or Ctrl+Alt+B to choose its base branch. ⌘⇧X or Ctrl+Shift+X now toggles shell mode in the composer.
item.content:encoded:
Press ⌘⌥O on macOS or Ctrl+Alt+O on Windows and Linux to choose a worktree, and ⌘⌥B or Ctrl+Alt+B to choose its base branch. ⌘⇧X or Ctrl+Shift+X now toggles shell mode in the composer.

Send Quotes From the Comment Popup

Hold ⌘ or Ctrl in the quote popup to turn its checkmark into send, or press ⌘Enter or Ctrl+Enter, to send just that quote and comment while leaving the rest of the composer untouched.

Percentage Compaction Buffer

Set "compaction": { "buffer": "20%" } in wormagent.json to keep a share of each model's context window free, so one setting fits models with small and large windows. Token counts still work.

Improvements

  • Core: When read misses because a folder is missing, the error names that folder and the nearest one that exists.
  • Core: When edit can't find oldString, the error shows the file's closest lines, or says the change is already there.
  • Core: Calls to a tool named bash now run as shell instead of failing, with the same permissions. A plugin tool actually named bash still takes precedence.
  • Desktop: Added flat input surfaces and a compact input size.

Fixes

  • Core: MCP servers that send stdio messages larger than 10 MiB no longer get disconnected, and large messages are read much faster.
  • Core: Idle locations no longer restart their MCP servers right after shutting down.
  • Core: Compaction now caps its prompt at the model's context window when the input limit is larger.
  • Core: LiteLLM context window errors now trigger compaction instead of stopping the session.
  • Core: Reasoning is no longer turned into plain text when you switch models or resume an interrupted response, which caused request errors on some providers.
  • Terminal, Desktop: The connect menu no longer lists MCP servers, which are managed in their own place.
  • Desktop: Added the missing top inset to the search field in the recently closed menu.

Released in v2.2.5

item.title: Persistent Desktop Terminals
item.description: Desktop terminals now belong to the session, survive server restarts with their scrollback, and stay synchronized with the TUI and other windows. Renamed terminals also keep their names across restarts.
item.content:encoded:
Desktop terminals now belong to the session, survive server restarts with their scrollback, and stay synchronized with the TUI and other windows. Renamed terminals also keep their names across restarts.

Publish Interactive Artifacts

Enable "experimental": { "artifacts": true } in wormagent.json to let agents publish, update, and serve HTML or static artifacts through the built-in local provider or plugin-provided storage.

Guided Claude Agent Setup

Select Claude Agent from the provider picker to copy claude auth login, install Claude Code, and verify the connection before continuing to model selection.

Choose a Base Branch Quickly

While creating a worktree, open Choose base branch with ⌘⌥. on macOS or Ctrl+Alt+. on Windows and Linux. The command is also available in the command palette and Settings › Shortcuts.

Improvements

  • Core: Made enabled schedules run under wormagent serve and coordinated multiple server processes so a schedule fires only once. Schedules remain opt-in through experimental.schedules.
  • Core: Raised WormAgent Go limits for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
  • Desktop: Simplified the session location popover and made long paths easier to read.
  • SDK: Extended client.experimental.persistentPty.update to rename terminals or clear a user title, and exposed userTitle plus persistent-pty.updated events.

Fixes

  • Core: Allowed user, project, and remote configuration to override Console-supplied provider names, limits, variants, settings, and headers.
  • Core: Kept local WormAgent service requests out of environment-configured proxies.
  • Core: Replaced Claude Code’s misleading /login instruction with claude auth login.
  • Terminal: Preserved prompt cursor styles applied by plugins when themes or unrelated prompt state change.
  • Terminal: Added missing right padding to edit and patch diffs.
  • Terminal: Extended the vertical session-tab activity pulse across the full tab width.
  • Desktop: Kept terminal tab clicks and rename fields attached to the intended tab.
  • Desktop: Listed matching commands before sessions in command-palette search.
  • Desktop: Restored copying user messages from an open actions menu.
  • Desktop: Reduced repeated work and allocations while streaming Markdown, especially in long sessions.

Released in v2.2.4

item.title: Use Claude Code in WormAgent
item.description: Install Claude Code, run claude auth login, then select Claude Agent in /connect to use your Claude Code login and models.
item.content:encoded:
Install Claude Code, run claude auth login, then select Claude Agent in /connect to use your Claude Code login and models.

Faster Long Sessions in Desktop

Streaming replies and long conversations now do much less rendering work.

Desktop Stability Fixes

Fixes side-panel tabs, repeated "Session not found" toasts, and Open file over HTTP.

Breaking changes

TUI plugins require OpenTUI 0.8 @wormagent/plugin now requires @opentui/core and @opentui/solid 0.8.0 or later. In OpenTUI 0.8, a ScrollBox's wrapper, viewport, content, and scrollbars are facade objects instead of renderables, and a custom RenderContext must implement clock and onAnimationTick. See the OpenTUI 0.8.0 release notes.

Managed policy: integration.use covers integrations only integration.use now controls which integration accounts can be used, and the new mcp.use, skill.use, and plugin.use actions control MCP servers, skills, and plugins. Rules with the old mcp:, skill:, and plugin: resource prefixes are converted automatically, but a bare integration.use rule no longer applies to MCP servers, skills, or plugins.

Improvements

  • Core: Added Code Mode JavaScript checks to experimental schedules, including statically authorized tool calls, persistent state, and custom wake messages.
  • Core: Added separate managed-policy actions for connecting to integrations and using integrations, MCP servers, skills, and plugins.
  • Terminal, SDK: Added lazy loading for stored image references when experimental.media_blob is enabled. Images are downloaded only for previews, while undo, revert, fork, and prompt recall restore referenced attachments safely.
  • Terminal: Added a distinct marker for the selected composer suggestion in the new designs.
  • Desktop: Added a Desktop spellcheck toggle under Settings → General and system-language dictionary selection on Windows and Linux.
  • Desktop: Added PageUp and PageDown timeline paging from the composer without moving the draft cursor or focus.
  • Desktop: Added independently configurable question notifications and sounds under Settings → Notifications → Questions.
  • Desktop: Added separate project and worktree actions to the new-session control.
  • Desktop: Added one-click version copying in Settings → About.
  • Desktop: Grouped added projects in workspace settings.
  • Desktop: Made question-answer text selectable.
  • Desktop: Adapted the session header to narrow timeline widths.
  • SDK: Preserved partial LLMResponse output on AIError.partial when generation, object generation, or a tool loop fails.
  • SDK: Unified Effect and Promise tool declarations around tool(...), with optional output schemas and executable or declaration-only tools.
  • SDK: Added typed OpenRouter debug, models, plugins, provider, and user options to the Responses route.
  • Extensions: Added persistent-terminal renaming to the process daemon, including capability discovery and user titles that override shell-provided titles until cleared.

Fixes

  • Core: Preserved plugin-provided model variants and delayed dynamic provider fallback until external SDK hooks have run.
  • Core: Preserved permission reasons and feedback in MCP failures, and made Code Mode failures match direct tool-call failures.
  • Core: Fixed invalid Code Mode schedule checks so creation fails immediately and existing invalid checks pause without repeated execution.
  • Core: Removed a session’s persistent terminals when the session is deleted.
  • Core: Kept nested tool progress from replacing the parent execute call rows.
  • Terminal: Fixed PHP syntax highlighting for code blocks without an opening <?php tag.
  • Terminal: Preserved # in file-search paths unless it introduces a valid line range.
  • Terminal: Kept the configured default cursor style after config reloads.
  • Terminal: Matched the search cursor to the highlighted row when a selection dialog has no query.
  • Desktop: Kept question options and submit controls reachable on mobile.
  • Desktop: Preserved simultaneous request notifications and inbox scroll position when opening sessions.
  • Desktop: Fixed consecutive dropped files so every file mention is inserted into the composer.
  • Desktop: Kept the current @ and command-menu selection stable while results update under a stationary pointer.
  • Desktop: Fixed ⌘W side-panel closing and focus restoration when no closable tabs remain.
  • Desktop: Kept the mobile session drawer open while a session loads.
  • Desktop: Restored maximized windows on their saved display and retained renderer permissions across shared-session windows.
  • Desktop: Fixed timeline growth, zoom-end scrolling, highlighting, and DOM-observer performance issues in long sessions.
  • Desktop: Kept models with unknown release dates visible.
  • Desktop: Fixed reasoning-capability detection for models that expose reasoning through variants or compatibility metadata.
  • Desktop: Fixed the macOS application icon and added the required folder-access description to the app bundle.
  • SDK: Matched the Promise AI client more closely to the Effect API and accepted typed tools in loops.
  • SDK: Kept tools whose execute handler can throw available to the AI client.
  • SDK: Continued polling queued media generations when providers return unknown intermediate statuses.
  • SDK: Stopped sending an incompatible filename alongside file_url on OpenAI Responses requests.
  • Extensions: Preserved null values in Code Mode text encoding.
  • Extensions: Tidied nested Extensions menus.

Add experimental image and decision generation APIs to plugins and sdk

Add experimental image and decision generation APIs to plugins and sdk, allowing image generation or decision model (think typesafe, clef, etc) workflows.

Plugins can now attach and update keyed session instructions with ctx.session.instructions.entry.put/list/remove

Plugins can now attach and update keyed session instructions with ctx.session.instructions.entry.put/list/remove. Instead of editing the system prompt and busting the prompt cache, each change is added as a small update at the next step. The entries also survive compaction and reverts, and they don't start an extra model turn.

@wormagent/ai root is now the Promise API @wormagent/ai now works like @wormagent/sdk and @wormagent/client: the package root exports the Promise API, and the Effect API moved to @wormagent/ai/effect. @wormagent/ai/promise is removed, and the wildcard subpath export is replaced with an explicit list of provider and protocol entry points. ``diff -import { AI } from "@wormagent/ai/promise" -import { LLM } from "@wormagent/ai" +import { AI } from "@wormagent/ai" +import { LLM } from "@wormagent/ai/effect" ``

The WormAgent GitHub Action is removed The WormAgent GitHub Action is no longer published. Remove it from your workflows.

TUI plugins require OpenTUI 0.7 @wormagent/plugin now requires @opentui/core and @opentui/solid 0.7.0, up from 0.6.8 or later. Plugins that depend on OpenTUI 0.6 fail to install until they upgrade. In OpenTUI 0.7, custom renderables read their hooks from their class at construction: assign renderBefore, renderAfter, and onLifecyclePass in the constructor instead of as class fields, call refreshHooks() after adding a hook by reflection, and replace defineNativeIntegration() with a static nativeIntegration declaration.
